articles.title: ‘We are not anyone’s proxy force’: Iranian Kurdish party
articles.summary: In an email interview with The Hindu, Rivar Abdanan, a spokesperson of PJAK and a member of the party’s Leadership Council, said PJAK would enter the war only if the ‘existence of the Kurdish people comes under threat’ ‘We are not anyone’s proxy force’: Iranian Kurdish party.

articles.title: Ukraine Hits At Iran In The Caspian Sea. And Things Get Even Messier.
articles.summary: Russia’s Iranian-designed drones have ravaged Ukrainian forces in Moscow’s all-out war. As far as Ukraine is concerned, that means cargo ships plying the Caspian Sea with Iranian military goods are fair game. Including this past weekend. Ukraine Hits At Iran In The Caspian Sea. And Things Get Even Messier.

articles.title: Javier Milei accuses US Democrats of financing ‘anti-Argentina campaign’ at World Cup
articles.summary: President also blames Brazil and Mexico and says online critics ‘do not want the ideas of freedom to succeed’More than a week has passed since Ferran Torres scored the extra-time goal that gave Spain its second World Cup, but – at least for Argentina’s president – the tournament is not over. Javier Milei accuses US Democrats of financing ‘anti-Argentina campaign’ at World Cup.

articles.title: Canada’s GCAP fighter move tests limits of US diversification
articles.summary: Canada’s entry into the Global Combat Air Program (GCAP) highlights a broader strategic dilemma: how to modernize its air force without deepening dependence on any single supplier or undermining the interoperability on which its defense commitments rely. This month, multiple media outlets reported that Canada officially joined the GCAP as its first observer nation, marking [] The post Canada’s GC.

articles.title: Zelenskyy To Meet Trump As Former Envoys See Chance To Cement US Support
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy arrived in Washington on July 28 at what may be one of the most consequential moments in US-Ukraine relations since Donald Trump's return to the White House, as Ukraine launched a large-scale drone attack on the Moscow region. Zelenskyy To Meet Trump As Former Envoys See Chance To Cement US Support.

articles.title: Vietnam’s smart-port push opens another door to Washington
articles.summary: Vietnam’s effort to modernize Da Nang’s maritime infrastructure may look at first like another Asian port-development project, but it is considerably more important than that. The transformation underway along Vietnam’s central coast brings together three priorities that increasingly define Hanoi’s foreign policy: economic modernization, technological self-reliance and stronger maritime awareness Vietnam’s smart-port push opens another door to Washington.

articles.title: Extreme rainfall across Asia brings flash floods and typhoons
articles.summary: From Afghanistan to Taiwan, unprecedented deluge highlights devastating impact of climate breakdown“It rained for 10 days and 10 nights, non-stop – I’d never seen anything like it,” says Anar Gul, a construction worker who lives in the remote district of Dur Baba in eastern Afghanistan. The houses in his village are built from stone and mud, which makes them extremely vulnerable to heavy rains.

articles.title: Iran War Drives Central Asian Countries To Seek Alternate Trade Routes
articles.summary: In an interview with RFE/RL, Ken Moriyasu, a senior fellow at the Hudson Institute, said the countries of Central Asia appear to be giving up on Iran as a gateway to global trade, a situation which is driving new approaches to cooperation with China and Pakistan. Iran War Drives Central Asian Countries To Seek Alternate Trade Routes.

articles.title: Central Asia Is Increasingly Looking Beyond Iran, Says Analyst Ken Moriyasu
articles.summary: Has the Iran conflict permanently reshaped Central Asia's strategic map? Hudson Institute senior fellow Ken Moriyasu explains why governments across the region are increasingly looking beyond Iran toward Pakistan, Afghanistan and China for trade, connectivity, and access to global markets. Central Asia Is Increasingly Looking Beyond Iran, Says Analyst Ken Moriyasu.

articles.title: Pinochet-era soldier jailed for killing folk singer Víctor Jara 53 years ago
articles.summary: Nelson Haase Mazzei was sentenced for murdering Víctor Jara in 2023, but fled from authorities in ChileMore than 50 years after the murder of the Chilean folk singer Víctor Jara, the last man wanted in connection with his death has been tracked down and brought to justice. Nelson Haase Mazzei was sentenced for murdering Jara in 2023, but fled from authorities in ChileMore than 50 years after the murder of the Chilean folk singer Víctor Jara, the last man wanted in connection with his death has been tracked down and brought to justice. Nelson Haase Mazzei, a retired colonel, fled from authorities in 2023 after he and six other retired soldiers were sentenced in absent.

articles.title: 60-Year-Old Ukrainian Volunteer Supplies Front Lines Amid Rise Of Unmanned Ground Vehicles
articles.summary: Russian drone attacks are making it increasingly dangerous to deliver supplies to Ukraine's frontline troops. While Kyiv is deploying unmanned ground vehicles for some risky missions, volunteers like 60-year-old Mykhaylo continue making supply runs the old-fashioned way in the Donetsk region. 60-Year-Old Ukrainian Volunteer Supplies Front Lines Amid Rise Of Unmanned Ground Vehicles.

articles.title: High prices and funding cuts stall HIV prevention revolution
articles.summary: The AIDS epidemic could stage a comeback amid unequal access to breakthrough prevention medicines and a sharp decline in global funding, according to a UN report released on Monday ahead of the opening of the 26th International AIDS Conference in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. High prices and funding cuts stall HIV prevention revolution.

articles.title: Bank Indonesia chief’s resignation signals a deep, hidden crisis
articles.summary: JAKARTA – Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo’s abrupt resignation marks a watershed moment for Southeast Asia’s largest economy. Coming midway through his second five-year term, Warjiyo’s departure. tendered for personal reasons and quickly accepted by President Prabowo Subianto. has rattled local and international financial markets. For seven years, Warjiyo served as an institutional [] The Bank Indonesia chief’s resignation signals a deep, hidden crisis.

articles.title: After Pakistan judge killing, a fight over who claims it
articles.summary: Modern terrorist attacks no longer end when the shooting stops. Increasingly, a second battle begins immediately afterward: the struggle over who receives credit. In an era of encrypted communications, instant messaging and digital propaganda, attaching an organization’s name to an attack can be almost as valuable as the hit itself. articles.title: Uganda begins emergency food handouts after 19 die from hunger
articles.summary: Government move follows months of drought and crop failures in Karamoja, with 1.5m people facing malnutritionUganda has launched emergency food relief distribution after at least 19 deaths from hunger were reported in an area of prolonged drought in the east of the country. Uganda begins emergency food handouts after 19 die from hunger.

articles.title: Zelenskyy Becomes First Foreign Visitor For New British PM Burnham
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is set to meet new British Prime Minister Andy Burnham in London on July 27 as he begins a big week of foreign talks amid a rising civilian death toll from Russian air strikes back home. Ukrainian Leader To Kick Off Big Week With London Meeting With New British PM. Zelenskyy To Kick Off Big Week With London Meeting With New British PM.

articles.title: Venezuelan men sue aviation firms who flew them to notorious Salvadorian jail
articles.summary: Exclusive: CSI Aviation and GlobalX accused of violating civil rights as part of Trump immigration crackdownVenezuelan men sent last year to a notorious Salvadorian terrorism prison by the Trump administration are suing the US aviation companies that transported them there. Venezuela men sue aviation firms who flew them to notorious Salvadorian jail. Venezuelan men sue aviation firms who flew them to notorious Salvadorian jail.

articles.title: Street-smart youth take their declaration to the UN
articles.summary: When Samantha Richards and Angela Hifume walked into the Hall of Flags at United Nations Headquarters last week, they carried more than a folder of paper. They carried the voices of hundreds of street-connected children who had never expected anyone to listen. Street-smart youth take their declaration to the UN.

articles.title: UN chief hails Syria’s ‘moment of possibility’ on first visit since fall of Assad regime
articles.summary: Syria has an opportunity not only to recover from conflict but to build “a future that is more stable, more inclusive and more prosperous for all Syrians”, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said in Damascus on Saturday as he began a landmark visit to the country. UN chief hails Syria’s ‘moment of possibility’ on first visit since fall of Assad regime.

articles.title: ‘Women do not stop giving birth in an emergency’ – one month after Venezuela quakes
articles.summary: One month after twin earthquakes rocked Venezuela, thousands of women and girls continue to face difficulty in accessing essential healthcare and protection services, a senior official with the UN reproductive and sexual health agency UNFPA said on Friday. ‘Women do not stop giving birth in an emergency’ – one month after Venezuela quakes.

articles.title: ईरान जंग शुरू होने के बाद ट्रंप-नेतन्याहू की पहली बैठक, मतभेदों के बीच क्या है इस्राइल का प्लान?
articles.summary: अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप और इस्राइल के प्रधानमंत्री बेंजामिन नेतन्याहू ने ईरान जंग शुरू होने के बाद अपनी पहली बैठक की। इस बैठक के दौरान, दोनों नेताओं ने ईरान के खिलाफ अपने संयुक्त प्रयासों पर चर्चा की। इस्राइल के प्लान के बारे में जानकारी सीमित है, लेकिन यह ज्ञात है कि दोनों देश ईरान के परमाणु कार्यक्रम को रोकने के लिए एक साथ काम करने के इच्छुक हैं।

articles.summary: लोकसभा में एनसीपीआई नेता सुदीप बंदोपाध्याय ने ममता बनर्जी की तृणमूल कांग्रेस से अलग हुए 19 सांसदों की सूची दी है. इनमें काकोली घोष दस्तीदार, शताब्दी रॉय, बापी हलदर और डॉ. शर्मिला सरकार शामिल हैं. यह सूची 18 मई को लोकसभा अध्यक्ष के कार्यालय को भेजी गई थी. लोकसभा में एनसीपीआई नेता सुदीप बंदोपाध्याय (कोलकाता उत्तर) ने ममता बनर्जी की तृणमूल कांग्रेस (टीएमसी) से अलग हुए 20 सांसदों में से 19 की सूची दी है, जिन्होंने 18 मई को लोकसभा अध्यक्ष के कार्यालय को अपने नाम भेजे थे.

articles.summary: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने दिल्ली के जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन के दौरान हुए लाठीचार्ज मामले में 8 राज्यों को नोटिस जारी किया है. चीफ जस्टिस ऑफ इंडिया सूर्यकांत ने कहा कि मामले की जांच होनी चाहिए और जवाबदेही तय होनी चाहिए. सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने राज्यों से कहा है कि वे जांच करें लेकिन अभी कोई एक्शन न लें. दिल्ली के जंतर-मंतर पर हुए प्रदर्शन के दौरान पुलिस ने लाठीचार्ज किया था और भीड़ को नियंत्रित करने के लिए आंसूगैस के गोले भी छोड़े थे.

articles.summary: पेरिस में एक व्यक्ति ने तीन महिलाओं पर चाकू से हमला किया। Paris Knife Attack: पेरिस में हाल ही में हुए एक हमले ने पूरे फ्रांस को हिला दिया है। यह घटना पेरिस के पोर्ते दे क्लिशी इलाके के पास हुई थी। इस दौरान एक व्यक्ति ने तीन महिलाओं पर अचानक चाकू से हमला कर दिया, जिससे इलाके में अफरा-तफरी मच गई।
